question: In Table 1D-2, how is 'Road Work' abbreviated on a portable changeable message sign, and what may follow it?
model_answer: Direct Answer: In Table 1D-2, "Road Work" is abbreviated as "RD WK" for use on portable changeable message signs. Because the table lists a prompt word following the abbreviation, RD WK should be followed by "Ahead" or a [Distance] (for example, "RD WK 1 MILE"). Standards (mandatory): - "When the word messages shown in Table 1D-2 need to be abbreviated on a portable changeable message sign, the abbreviations shown in Table 1D-2 shall be used. Unless indicated by an asterisk, these abbreviations shall only be used on portable changeable message signs." Since RD WK carries no asterisk, it is restricted to portable changeable message signs. Guidance (recommended): - "The abbreviations for the words listed in Table 1D-2 that also show a prompt word should not be used on a portable changeable message sign... unless the prompt word shown in Table 1D-2 either precedes or follows the abbreviation, as applicable." For RD WK, the prompt word following the abbreviation is "Ahead, [Distance]". Visual evidence: - [Image 1] Table 1D-2 (Sheet 1 of 2) shows the row "Road Work" with Standard Abbreviation "RD WK", no preceding prompt word (—), the prompt word following the abbreviation listed as "Ahead, [Distance]", and the example "RD WK 1 MILE". - [Image 2] Page 77 shows the same Table 1D-2 (Sheet 1 of 2) row confirming "Road Work / RD WK / — / Ahead, [Distance] / RD WK 1 MILE". - [Image 3] Page 78 shows Table 1D-2 (Sheet 2 of 2), which does not contain the Road Work entry but confirms the table's format and footnotes. - [Image 4] Page 559 (Table 2L-4) illustrates related message construction for portable CMS, noting that condensing ROAD and WORK into "ROADWORK" (per Table 1D-2 considerations) can accommodate a single-phase message, and that less common abbreviations are not warranted when the sign can accommodate the full message. - [Image 5] Page 873 (Section 6L.05) states that when word messages in Tables 1D-1 or 1D-2 need to be abbreviated on a portable changeable message sign, the provisions of Section 1D.08 shall be followed. Citations: - Section 1D.08 Standard §2 (p.34) - Section 1D.08 Guidance §3 (p.34) - Table 1D-2 (p.36) - Page 77
gold_answer: RD WK; it may be followed by AHEAD or a distance, such as 'RD WK 1 MILE.'
